notes: Fixes the 0.9.10/0.9.11 start problem (Start failed at once with a selector error). Runs finish on low-memory PCs and with unusual microphone chains; speakers whose finest correction detail the receiver can't reproduce keep a broad-stroke correction instead of none; up-firing speakers with strong room reflections calibrate (enter the ceiling height when the log lacks it); a polarity-switch advisory for shared-sub receivers; seats close to the surround/back speakers no longer stop at the final distance check; refreshed Review graphs. Install over your current version — settings and results carry over.
